basis.derived: batch item: tokens x batch price, cached input at a tenth of the input price (reproduces the billed batch total)
basis.unbilled: HTTP 4xx rejection before any generation; billed $0
basis.unknown: no generation ID or usage (client timeout or upstream 5xx); not counted
basis.subq_rate: SubQ Snap: input tokens x SubQ's published $0.05 per million (output is free)

fields: board total for this model and study (None if any request on it has an unknown cost)
